en.title: RBI interest-rate decision
en.meaning: RBI decides interest rates. A change can move the rupee, and a weaker rupee makes gold dearer here. Nobody knows the decision in advance.

en.title: US Federal Reserve decision
en.meaning: US interest rates move the world gold price, which Indian prices follow. Big surprises can move prices a lot in a day.

en.title: US Federal Reserve decision
en.meaning: Same as above. The Fed calls its dates tentative until confirmed at the meeting before.

en.title: Union Budget 2027-28
en.meaning: Import duty on gold and silver is often changed in the Budget. A duty change moves prices here on the same day. In recent years the Budget has been presented on 1 February; this year's date is not announced yet.

en.title: RBI interest-rate decision
en.meaning: Same as the December decision: it can move the rupee, and so the gold price here.
